hook: A dead man leashed to a ship's wheel arrived in 1890.

sections.voiceover: A dead man leashed to a ship's wheel arrived in 1890.
sections.visual_cue: A dark, misty 19th-century harbour scene showing a schooner at the dock.

sections.voiceover: In August 1890, a schooner ran aground in Whitby harbour with a dead man leashed. Can Sherlock Holmes use his legendary logic to defeat the vampire Count Dracula in this crossover?
sections.visual_cue: Map of the Yorkshire coastline zooming in on the town of Whitby.

sections.voiceover: The schooner's arrival in Whitby harbour triggers strange nocturnal crimes that demand the detective's immediate intervention.
sections.visual_cue: Close up on an old, leather-bound book with the title Sherlock Holmes vs. Dracula.

sections.voiceover: Author Loren D. Estleman wrote the 1978 novel Sherlock Holmes vs. Dracula to detail this encounter. BBC Radio 4 later adapted this battle between the detective and the vampire in 1981.
sections.visual_cue: A split screen showing a magnifying glass on the left and a vampire crest on the right.

sections.voiceover: The clash of logic and blood began in 1890.
sections.visual_cue: Silhouette of Sherlock Holmes standing against a full moon.
